name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns for Server Components, streaming, routing, fetching, caching, Server Actions, and SSR/SSG.

Modes: Server Components for data, computation, secrets; Client Components for interactivity, hooks, browser APIs; static for rarely changing content; dynamic for personalized or real-time content; streaming for slow data.

Route files: layout.tsx, page.tsx, loading.tsx, error.tsx, not-found.tsx, route.ts, template.tsx, default.tsx, opengraph-image.tsx.

Paths: app/layout.tsx; app/page.tsx; app/products/page.tsx; components/products/ProductList.tsx; components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx; app/actions/cart.ts; app/dashboard/layout.tsx; app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/page.tsx; app/dashboard/<REDACTED_USER>/loading.tsx; app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx; app/photos/[id]/page.tsx; app/product/[id]/page.tsx; app/api/products/route.ts; app/api/products/[id]/route.ts; app/products/[slug]/page.tsx.

Patterns: Fetch in Server Components; await promise-based params and searchParams. Use Suspense for independently loading sections, parallel routes for dashboard slots, and intercepting routes for photo modals. Use Server Actions for cart and checkout mutations; validate required fields, then redirect to confirmation. Route handlers use NextRequest and NextResponse. Use generateMetadata, generateStaticParams, and notFound for product pages. Caching: fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" }); fetch(url, { cache: "force-cache" }); fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 } }); fetch(url, { next: { tags: ["products"] } }); import { revalidateTag, revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

**Start with Server Components** - Add 'use client' only when needed
**Colocate data fetching** - Fetch data where it's used
**Use Suspense boundaries** - Enable streaming for slow data
**Leverage parallel routes** - Independent loading states
**Use Server Actions** - For mutations with progressive enhancement
**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
